# DevToolDock

> Free online developer tools and AI-powered utilities. Format JSON, decode JWTs, convert files, test regex, generate code, and automate development tasks — all running in the browser, no sign-up required.

## Core tools
- [JSON Formatter](https://www.devtooldock.com/json-formatter): Format, validate, and beautify JSON.
- [JSON Validator](https://www.devtooldock.com/json-validator): Validate JSON syntax with clear error messages.
- [Base64 Encoder](https://www.devtooldock.com/base64-encoder): Encode text to Base64.
- [Base64 Decoder](https://www.devtooldock.com/base64-decoder): Decode Base64 to text.
- [JWT Decoder](https://www.devtooldock.com/jwt-decoder): Decode and inspect JWT tokens.
- [JWT Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/jwt-generator): Create a signed JWT (HS256).
- [Regex Tester](https://www.devtooldock.com/regex-tester): Test regular expressions and highlight matches.
- [UUID Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/uuid-generator): Generate UUID v4 identifiers.
- [SHA256 Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/sha256-generator): Compute SHA-256 hashes.
- [Password Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/password-generator): Generate secure random passwords.

## AI tools
- [AI Code Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/ai/code-generator): Generate code from natural-language prompts.
- [AI SQL Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/ai/sql-generator): Convert plain text to SQL queries.
- [AI Regex Generator](https://www.devtooldock.com/ai/regex-generator): Generate regex patterns from descriptions.
- [AI Code Refactor Tool](https://www.devtooldock.com/ai/code-refactor): Improve and refactor existing code.
